verdict.label: Heavy review / verification
verdict.summary: Developing a LinkedIn Marketing integration requires an approved developer application, explicit advertising API access approval, and tier-specific upgrades.
verdict.cost: Free to apply; API access tiers and partner requirements determined by LinkedIn.

composioFit.summary: Composio does not manage a pre-built OAuth app for LinkedIn Ads, so you must bring your own custom OAuth app credentials.
whyOwnApp: Required for custom API permissions, scope tuning, and dedicated rate limits.

phases.name: Create Developer Application
steps: Sign in to the LinkedIn Developer Portal.
Create a developer application in the Developer Portal.
Select your app from My Apps, navigate to the Products tab, and add the Advertising API product.
phases.handoff: Provide your Client ID and Client Secret to configure your custom auth config.

phases.name: Configure OAuth and Redirect URIs
steps: Add the redirect (callback) URL via HTTPS to your server or Composio callback URL.
Confirm required permissions under the Auth tab for your app.
phases.handoff: Ready to test authentication code flow and token exchange.

phases.name: Test with Developer Tokens
steps: Use the Developer Portal Token Generator or Postman workspace to generate an access token for testing.
Make authenticated API calls for testing.
phases.handoff: Complete end-to-end integration and workflow testing before requesting standard tier access.

phases.name: Apply for Standard Tier / Review
steps: After you build and test your application, apply for Standard tier access.
Submit a tier upgrade request with a video demonstrating how your platform creates, edits, or optimizes LinkedIn campaigns.
phases.handoff: Wait for LinkedIn review and approval.

artefacts.body: Our application requests r_ads and rw_ads to enable authorized users to manage, retrieve reporting data for, and optimize their ad accounts and campaigns through an AI agent assistant.

artefacts.title: Standard Tier Upgrade Request
artefacts.body:
Subject: Request for Advertising API Standard Tier Access - [Your App Name]

Hello LinkedIn Developer Support,

We have built and tested our integration using the Development tier. We are now requesting an upgrade to the Advertising API Standard tier to support live campaign management solutions with unlimited ad accounts.

Attached is our demonstration video showcasing our platform's capabilities.

Thank you,
[Your Name]

redirectRules.rule: Add the redirect (callback) URL via HTTPS to your server.
If you are using Postman to test this flow, use https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/callback as your redirect URL and enable Authorize using browser.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI validation error or invalid redirect URL error during auth code request.
blockers.cause: Using HTTP instead of HTTPS, or using an unregistered callback URL.
blockers.fix: Ensure all redirect URLs use HTTPS and exactly match the URLs defined in your developer application configuration.
blockers.fallback: Check the developer portal redirect settings and update your auth config.

blockers.symptom: Authorization code exchange fails or returns error.
blockers.cause: The authorization code has a 30-minute lifespan and must be used immediately.
blockers.fix: Restart the OAuth flow to obtain a fresh authorization code and exchange it immediately.
blockers.fallback: Automate code exchange directly in your callback handler to avoid manual delays.

blockers.symptom: Application returns a 401 Unauthorized error code.
blockers.cause: The value returned in the state parameter does not match the state value from your original authorization code request (CSRF check failure).
blockers.fix: Ensure state storage and validation correctly persist across the redirect roundtrip.
blockers.fallback: Disable strict state checks only during isolated local debugging.

checklist.text: Create a developer application in the LinkedIn Developer Portal.
Add the Advertising API product under the Products tab.
Configure the redirect (callback) URL via HTTPS.
Confirm access to required permissions in the Developer Portal under the Auth tab.
Generate an access token using the Developer Portal Token Generator or Postman.
Build and test application end-to-end workflows in the Development tier.
Record demonstration video showing campaign creation, editing, or optimization.
Submit tier upgrade request for Advertising API Standard tier.
